method: Qualitative web-search sample, up to five results per query. Configured SearXNG unavailable; Exa fallback returned results. Not a localized Google SERP, no demand/competition scores inferred.

queries.observation: Four returned manufacturer articles plus a cooperation-labeled review. The practical answer already exists; opportunity is clearer mode-by-mode separation and decision matrix, not claiming an empty niche.

queries.retry: Momcozy S12 Pro Quick vs S12 Pro comparison
queries.observation: Broader retry found official comparison, FAQ, product and specification pages plus a review. Empty first result is not evidence of no competition. Contradictory official noise and parts figures create a fact-checking task, not a ranking promise.

Returned manufacturer pages across regions and an Amazon category. Exact model-code query is largely product/retail oriented in this sample. German bundle decision and explicit destination-variant labeling are useful, but German search volume is unmeasured.

Official FAQ and set lists already answer the core distinction. Added editorial value is hub count versus spare-bottle count, regional set caveat and clear separation from Stride; not an invented test.
